name: Stratum
what_it_is: Stratum is an open-source, silicon-independent switch operating system for software-defined networks (SDN) that exposes next-generation SDN interfaces including P4Runtime and OpenConfig/gNMI to enable programmability and interchangeability across networking devices. It provides a hardware abstraction layer supporting Tofino-based ASICs, Broadcom Tomahawk/Trident chip families, Intel PAC N3000 smart NICs, and software-based switches (bmv2).
components: gNMI server (network device management over gRPC)
Physical Hardware Access Layer (PHAL) for device-specific operations
SDKLT interface for fixed-pipeline Broadcom Tomahawk switches
protocols: gRPC (transport layer for P4Runtime and gNMI)
measurement: gNMI streaming telemetry (subscribe to operational state paths)
Config Monitoring Service for configuration state tracking
Logging framework for debug and operational visibility
gNMI-supported paths documentation for observable counters and state
configuration: P4Runtime for forwarding pipeline (P4 program) configuration
gNMI for device and interface configuration
OpenConfig YANG models for structured configuration
CLI tools: gNMI CLI, PHAL CLI, ONLP CLI
modes: Hardware mode: Tofino-based ASIC switches (requires Barefoot SDE)
Hardware mode: Broadcom Tomahawk/Trident switches (requires Broadcom SDK6)
Hardware mode: Intel PAC N3000 smart NIC
Software mode: bmv2 behavioral model switch (no hardware required)
Software mode: dummy switch (stub for development/testing)
constraints: Tofino hardware mode requires Barefoot SDE access (not freely distributable — pre-built binaries behind vendor agreement)
Broadcom SDK6 requires a vendor SLA or direct Broadcom relationship to obtain
Hardware support limited to explicitly listed platforms; arbitrary ASICs not supported without porting work
No native support for sFlow, NetFlow, IPFIX, or packet-sampling telemetry protocols
No in-band network telemetry (INT) support mentioned
No docker-compose file found in the repository root (no containerized multi-service deployment definition)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in the repository
No fault injection or chaos testing framework
No sFlow, NetFlow, or IPFIX packet-sampling support
No BGP, OSPF, or routing protocol stack (SDN control plane delegated to external controller)
